capabilities: Journal each trade as a Markdown note with a trade card, review fields and charts
Analyze performance on a dashboard with equity curve, ratios, custom calculation cards and goals
Import MetaTrader, CSV or Excel statements or add trades by hand
Write day reports and recurring reviews from editable question templates
Track prop firm challenge rules and run guided trading sessions with a trade gate
extras: Freemium: sync, review questions, goals, prop firm tracking and session mode need paid Tradoshi plans; without an account only 20 imported trades work. Source is MIT-licensed and detailed docs with screenshots live on the Tradoshi site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record, sync and analyze trading performance, so traders must keep their journal and broker history in separate tools.

relations.evidence: Sync with Tradoshi: your trades arrive on their own, from your brokers and from the app.

requires.name: Tradoshi paid plan (Essential, Pro or Premium)

summary: Trading journal that writes each trade as a Markdown note, with an analytics dashboard, trade log, day reports, reviews, setups and prop firm challenge tracking.
